Class UserController

java.lang.Object
com.ex.tennistournament.controller.UserController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/users") public class UserController extends Object
REST Controller for managing user accounts. Handles user operations including queries, updates, and deletions. Security: - Admin access required for user listing and deletion - Self-service operations for password updates - Uses @PreAuthorize for role-based authorization Features: - User CRUD operations - User type filtering - Password management - Input validation Validations: - Request body validation using @Valid - User existence checks - Password complexity rules - User type constraints Integration: - Works with UserService for business logic - Uses UserDto for data transfer - Handles UserType enum for user categories
